goal: Measure required category leaf coverage instead of counting visited links
method: Keep only verified required category ancestry
Record retailer reported item count and page count for every reviewed leaf
Record unique product IDs observed on every page
Compare reviewed pages and unique IDs against reported values
Keep incomplete, failed and unresolved leaves explicit
Use observed facets only when a real pagination cap prevents completion
completion_rule: No full-coverage claim until every required leaf and page is reconciled

next_test.purpose: Validate live reported counts, unique IDs and reconciliation output

first_test.finding: Reported totals include sponsored placements; reporting now separates all listed IDs from eligible non-sponsored IDs

second_test.finding: Reported count measures placements and can include repeated sponsored or marketplace items; page completion therefore uses reconciled pagination while count differences remain visible
